name: Novixa Addons for Elementor
author: Ali Hossain

sections.description:
Novixa Addons for Elementor gives you 56 lightweight, beautifully designed widgets in one plugin. It works with free Elementor, so no Pro license is needed. Drag a widget onto your page, pick a preset, and you are done.

Every widget is a separate module. Turn off what you don’t use under Novixa Addons > Elements and nothing extra loads on your site.

Highlights

  • 56 widgets, one plugin – replace several addon plugins with a single one.
  • Premium presets – ready-made styles for pricing, team, testimonials, products and more.
  • Fast – assets load only on pages that use a widget.
  • Fully customizable – typography, colors, spacing, borders, shadows, hover effects and responsive controls.
  • Accessible and SEO friendly – keyboard support, reduced-motion support, FAQ and review schema.
  • WooCommerce ready – AJAX product grid with filters, quick view and add to cart.

Popular widgets

  • Pricing Table – 10 presets, monthly / yearly toggle, comparison matrix.
  • Form Builder – multi-step forms, conditional logic, 20+ fields, email alerts, spam protection, optional Stripe / PayPal payments.
  • Testimonial Carousel – 9 presets, star ratings, autoplay, review schema.
  • Product Grid (WooCommerce) – 8 presets, AJAX filters, quick view, infinite scroll.
  • Product Carousel (WooCommerce) – 4 presets, product source queries, category tabs, autoplay, infinite loop, drag / swipe, AJAX add to cart, quick view.
  • Post Slider & Carousel – 5 presets, posts / pages / custom post types, Latest / Featured / Popular / Related, AJAX category tabs and search, autoplay, infinite loop, drag / swipe.
  • Team Member – 10 presets in grid, carousel or list layouts.
  • Countdown Timer – 9 presets with timezones and CTA.
  • Smart FAQ Search and Accordion – live search and FAQ schema.
  • Interactive Location Map – OpenStreetMap or Google Maps with search and filters.

All widgets

  • Text: Heading, Advanced Heading, Dual Color Heading, Gradient Text Effect, Text Editor
  • Buttons: Button, Overlay Button, Icon Badge Button, Advanced Button
  • Forms and Pricing: Form Builder, Pricing Table
  • Boxes and Cards: Icon Box, Diamond Icon Box, Image Box, Feature Card, Numbered Feature Box, Image Caption Card, Content Reveal on Hover, Neumorphic Showcase
  • Accordions and Tabs: Accordion, Interactive Accordion Showcase, Smart FAQ Search, Icon Accordion, Tabs, Tabs (Nested)
  • Stats and Timers: Counter, Liquid Counter, Progress Bar & Skill Chart, Countdown Timer, Rotating Text Badge, Video Play Button
  • Marquees and Sliders: List Marquee, Logo Marquee, Images Marquee, Logo Carousel, Testimonial Carousel, Post Slider & Carousel
  • Images: Before / After, Image Gallery, Portfolio Grid, Image Hotspot, Expanding Panels, Hero Showcase Slider, Premium Hero Slider, Interactive Image Collage, Process Flow Diagram
  • Content and Search: Post List, Universal Search, Tooltip, Announcement Bar
  • People: Team Member
  • WooCommerce: Product Grid, Product Carousel
  • Maps and Timelines: Interactive Location Map, Geotag Hub, Luxury Timeline

Perfect for

Business sites, agencies, portfolios, SaaS landing pages, WooCommerce stores, restaurants, real estate and blogs. Works with any Elementor-compatible theme such as Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress, Kadence and Blocksy.

External services

The Interactive Location Map widget connects to third-party services only when you use it:

  • OpenStreetMap tile servers (or the tile URL you enter) load map images in the visitor’s browser. Visitor IP addresses are sent to the tile provider. https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/ – https://wiki.osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy
  • OpenFreeMap (tiles.openfreemap.org) serves the vector map data and style for the “OpenStreetMap look – English labels” map styles (the default). Requests are made from the visitor’s browser. https://openfreemap.org/tos/ – https://openfreemap.org/privacy/
  • Esri World Street Map tiles (the “Esri Streets” style, and the automatic fallback if the vector map cannot load) load map images from server.arcgisonline.com in the visitor’s browser. https://www.esri.com/en-us/legal/privacy – https://www.esri.com/en-us/legal/terms/full-master-agreement
  • Google Maps JavaScript API loads only when you choose Google Maps and enter your own API key. https://policies.google.com/privacy – https://cloud.google.com/maps-platform/terms
  • OpenStreetMap Nominatim looks up coordinates for an address only if you enable “Look Up Missing Coordinates From Address”, only while you edit in Elementor, and the result is cached. Address text is sent to nominatim.openstreetmap.org. https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/
  • The Get Directions button links to Google Maps or OpenStreetMap; nothing is sent until a visitor clicks it.

The Video Play Button widget loads a video player only after a visitor clicks play, and only for the source you choose:

  • YouTube (youtube.com / youtube-nocookie.com) and Vimeo (player.vimeo.com) embeds load in the visitor’s browser. https://policies.google.com/privacy – https://vimeo.com/privacy

The Form Builder widget connects to third-party services only if you switch them on:

  • Google reCAPTCHA (google.com/recaptcha), hCaptcha (hcaptcha.com) or Cloudflare Turnstile (challenges.cloudflare.com) load a spam-check script in the visitor’s browser, and the response token is verified from your server. https://policies.google.com/privacy – https://www.hcaptcha.com/privacy – https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/
  • Stripe (api.stripe.com) creates a checkout session and receives webhooks, only when you enable the Stripe gateway and add your keys. Card details are entered on Stripe’s own page and never reach your site. https://stripe.com/privacy – https://stripe.com/legal/ssa
  • PayPal (api-m.paypal.com) creates and verifies orders, only when you enable the PayPal gateway and add your credentials. https://www.paypal.com/webapps/mpp/ua/privacy-full – https://www.paypal.com/webapps/mpp/ua/useragreement-full

Credits

Leaflet 1.9.4 (BSD-2-Clause, https://leafletjs.com), Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3 (MIT), MapLibre GL JS 4.7.1 (BSD-3-Clause, https://maplibre.org) and @maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet 0.0.22 (ISC) are bundled locally in assets/vendor/.

Country flags in the Form Builder telephone selector use the “Twemoji Country Flags” font (https://github.com/talkjs/country-flag-emoji-polyfill, MIT) built from Twemoji graphics (c) Twitter, Inc. and contributors, licensed CC-BY 4.0.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the novixa-addons-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin and make sure Elementor is active.
  3. Go to Novixa Addons > Elements and enable the widgets you want.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor and search for “Novixa”.
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor Pro?

No. Free Elementor is enough.

Is it free?

Yes. All 54 widgets are included and licensed under GPLv2 or later.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Widgets are modular and load their CSS and JavaScript only where used. Disabled widgets load nothing.

Is there a pricing table or contact form widget?

Yes. Pricing Table and Form Builder are both included.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The Product Grid widget needs WooCommerce to be active.

Is it responsive and accessible?

Yes. Every widget has responsive controls, keyboard support and reduced-motion support.
